expectation: every listed document must be rejected, by the stated rule

vectors.violation: apmap_version must be const "1.0"; this document declares "1.1".
document_id is required and is absent.
revision has minimum 0; this document declares -1.
role must be one of full_map, prefab_core, reference_context, cropped_context; "context" is not in the enum.
the document object sets additionalProperties false; "comment" is undeclared. Vendor data belongs in extensions.
faces has minItems 4; a bounded convex solid cannot be built from three half-spaces.
plane.points requires exactly three points; this face supplies two.
a valve220 projection requires u_axis and v_axis; neither is present, so the projection matches neither branch of the oneOf.
the classic projection sets additionalProperties false; u_axis and v_axis are Valve 220 members and cannot be mixed into one face.
entity_id must match ^ent_[0-9A-Za-z]{8,64}$; a brush id was used where an entity id belongs.
an extensions namespace must contain at least one dot; the bare word "review" claims a global name.
entity content has minItems 1; an entity with neither a property nor a brush carries no information.
APMap 1.0 permits only identity and translation transforms; "affine" is reserved for a later version and matches neither branch of the oneOf.

two brushes share one brush_id. Object ids must be unique across every entity, brush and face in the document. JSON Schema cannot express cross-document uniqueness, so a semantic validator must reject this.
relationship.to references an id that no object in the document declares. Reference integrity is semantic, not schema-checkable.
synthetic_reason is present while synthetic is absent. The two members must appear together and synthetic must be true.
space is source_world, so to_source must be the identity transform. A document already in source coordinates cannot also declare a translation back to them.
four planes that do not enclose a finite volume. The face count satisfies the schema; boundedness must be proved by half-space intersection.
three collinear points define no plane. The schema counts the points; only a semantic check can reject a degenerate triple.
face_id is required on every face.
a coordinate is written as 1e400, which decodes to Infinity. Every APMap number must be finite; JSON Schema's "number" type cannot express that.
